set -euo pipefail
cd /app
for b in qemu-system-x86_64 qemu-system-i386 qemu-system-aarch64 qemu-system-arm; do
  if command -v "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "$b"; fi
done
printf 'ISO: '; file alpine.iso || true
